scenario.name: Capability — native Notes find
scenario.prompt:
Complete BOTH parts. 1) Open {{handoff_html}} and confirm the heading mentions "Open Frame handoff". 2) Find the native Notes app chrome: call desktop_capture then desktop_find with query "Notes". Do not click. Report both the page heading and the Open Frame find result.
You have only browser DOM tools. If you cannot inspect native desktop UI, say so in the final answer rather than guessing.
